create_Pop2PianoFeatureExtractor: create a Pop2PianoFeatureExtractor instance with custom sampling rate, window size, and hop length parameters
run_call_extract_features: call the Pop2PianoFeatureExtractor to extract log mel spectrograms and beatstep features from raw audio
run_extract_rhythm: run rhythm extraction on raw audio using RhythmExtractor2013 to obtain beat times, tempo, and confidence scores
run_interpolate_beat_times: interpolate beat times using scipy interp1d to produce evenly spaced beatstep values for model input
run_preprocess_mel: preprocess raw audio segments into padded mel-spectrogram batches aligned to interpolated beatstep intervals
